verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents a per-task `concurrencyLimit` on queues, which caps concurrency per workflow (docs-8). Its concurrency keys support per-user or per-tenant queue logic, so one hot customer can be isolated (docs-27). However, the evidence shows no user-configurable rate limiting per task, key, or tenant; the Limits page only displays platform quotas and rate-limit usage (docs-9). Missing for 10: user-defined rate limits per workflow/key/tenant, in-depth docs on concurrency-key semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration of tenant isolation.
